# Code Of Conduct

This project follows a simple standard:

- be respectful
- be constructive
- assume good intent
- focus on the work, not the person

## Unacceptable behavior

- harassment, hate speech, or personal attacks
- doxxing or sharing private information
- repeated disruptive behavior after feedback

## Enforcement

Maintainers may edit, hide, lock, or remove content that violates this policy, and may restrict participation if needed.

## Reporting

Open a private report via repository maintainers and include links or screenshots when possible.
